args.title: Filter out empty lines in src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Filter out completely empty lines (or lines containing only whitespace/cr) when splitting or parsing lines in parseStatement, so that trailing newlines or Windows CRLF line endings do not cause empty lines to be treated as malformed data rows.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/ingest/parser.ts, text.split("\n") creates an empty string line when the file ends with a newline, but the check lines[lines.length - 1] === "" only pops the last line if it's empty, and if there are multiple trailing newlines or Windows CRLF line endings (\r\n), lines ending with \r are not popped and are parsed as a row with incorrect field count. We should filter out completely empty lines or lines containing only whitespace/cr when parsing lines in parseStatement so that trailing newlines don't cause malformed data row errors.
